```{r setup, include=FALSE}
knitr::opts_chunk$set(echo = TRUE,
                      warning = FALSE,
                      message = FALSE)

library(tidyverse)
library(here)

# For text mining:

library(pdftools)
library(tidytext)
library(textdata)
library(ggwordcloud)
library(RColorBrewer)
library(patchwork)
```

## R Markdown


```{r}
pdf_text <- pdf_text("data/presidents_speeches.pdf")

presidents_speeches_text <- tibble(page = 1:length(pdf_text), text = pdf_text) %>%
  unnest_tokens(line, text, token = "lines") %>%
  filter(str_squish(line) != "") %>%
  mutate(linenum = row_number())

presidents_speeches_text <- presidents_speeches_text %>%
  mutate(chapter = cumsum(str_detect(line, regex("^(George W. Bush 1|George W. Bush 2|Barack H. Obama 1|Barack H. Obama 2|Donald J. Trump 1|Joseph R. Biden 1|Donald J. Trump 2)", ignore_case = TRUE))))

presidents_speeches_words <- presidents_speeches_text %>%
  unnest_tokens(word, line)

bing <- get_sentiments("bing")

presidents_speeches_sentiment <- presidents_speeches_words %>%
  inner_join(bing, by = "word") %>%
  count(chapter, sentiment) %>%
  pivot_wider(names_from = sentiment, values_from = n, values_fill = 0) %>%
  mutate(net_sentiment = positive - negative)

ggplot(presidents_speeches_sentiment, aes(x = chapter, y = net_sentiment)) +
  geom_col(fill = "darkred") +
  labs(title = "Net Sentiment per Presidents Speeches",
       x = "Speech", y = "Net Sentiment") +
  theme_minimal()
```

## Including Plots


```{r pressure, echo=FALSE}
nrc <- get_sentiments("nrc")

presidents_speeches_nrc <- presidents_speeches_words %>%
  inner_join(nrc, by = "word")

nrc_summary <- presidents_speeches_nrc %>%
  count(chapter, sentiment)

nrc_summary %>%
  filter(sentiment == "fear") %>%
  ggplot(aes(x = chapter, y = n)) +
  geom_line(color = "purple", size = 1.2) +
  labs(title = "Fear Emotion Across *presidents speeches*",
       x = "Speech", y = "Word Count (Fear)") +
  theme_minimal()

nrc_summary %>%
  filter(sentiment %in% c("joy", "fear", "anger", "sadness")) %>%
  ggplot(aes(x = chapter, y = n, color = sentiment)) +
  geom_line(size = 1.1) +
  labs(title = "Selected Emotions Across Presidents speeches",
       x = "Speech", y = "Count of Emotion Words") +
  theme_minimal()
```

Note that the `echo = FALSE` parameter was added to the code chunk to prevent printing of the R code that generated the plot.

```{r}
emotion_counts <- presidents_speeches_nrc %>%
  count(chapter, sentiment)

ggplot(emotion_counts, aes(x = chapter, y = sentiment, fill = n)) +
  geom_tile(color = "white") +
  scale_fill_gradient(low = "white", high = "darkred") +
  labs(title = "Emotion Heatmap Across Presidents speeches",
       x = "Speeches", y = "Emotion", fill = "Word Count") +
  theme_minimal() +
  theme(axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 90, vjust = 0.5),
        plot.title = element_text(size = 14, face = "bold"))
```
```{r}
chapter_length <- presidents_speeches_words %>%
  count(chapter, name = "total_words")

emotion_normalized <- emotion_counts %>%
  left_join(chapter_length, by = "chapter") %>%
  mutate(freq = n / total_words)

ggplot(emotion_normalized, aes(x = chapter, y = sentiment, fill = freq)) +
  geom_tile(color = "white") +
  scale_fill_gradient(low = "white", high = "darkred") +
  labs(title = "Normalized Emotion Heatmap Across Presidents speeches",
       x = "Speeches", y = "Emotion", fill = "Frequency") +
  theme_minimal() +
  theme(axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 90, vjust = 0.5),
        plot.title = element_text(size = 14, face = "bold"))
```
```{r}
emotion_normalized <- emotion_normalized %>%
  mutate(freq_pct = freq * 100)

ggplot(emotion_normalized, aes(x = chapter, y = sentiment, fill = freq_pct)) +
  geom_tile(color = "white") +
  scale_fill_viridis_c(option = "C", name = "Emotion %") +
  labs(title = "Normalized Emotion Heatmap Across Speeches",
       x = "Speeches", y = "Emotion") +
  theme_minimal()
```
```{r}
afinn <- get_sentiments("afinn")

presidents_speeches_afinn <- presidents_speeches_words %>%
  inner_join(afinn, by = "word")

afinn_chapter_sentiment <- presidents_speeches_afinn %>%
  group_by(chapter) %>%
  summarise(
    sentiment_score = sum(value),
    word_count = n()
  )

chapter_length <- presidents_speeches_words %>%
  count(chapter, name = "total_words")

afinn_chapter_sentiment <- afinn_chapter_sentiment %>%
  left_join(chapter_length, by = "chapter") %>%
  mutate(
    sentiment_per_word = sentiment_score / total_words
  )

ggplot(afinn_chapter_sentiment, aes(x = chapter, y = sentiment_per_word)) +
  geom_line(color = "steelblue", size = 1.2) +
  geom_smooth(method = "loess", se = FALSE, color = "darkred", linetype = "dashed") +
  labs(title = "AFINN Sentiment Across Presidents speeches",
       x = "Speech", y = "Average Sentiment per Word") +
  theme_minimal()

ggplot(afinn_chapter_sentiment, aes(x = chapter, y = sentiment_score)) +
  geom_col(fill = "darkgreen") +
  labs(title = "Total AFINN Sentiment Score per Presidents Speech",
       x = "Speech",
       y = "Total Sentiment Score") +
  theme_minimal()
```

```{r}
speech_words <- presidents_speeches_words %>%
  anti_join(stop_words, by = "word") %>%
  count(chapter, word, sort = TRUE)

top_words <- speech_words %>%
  group_by(chapter) %>%
  slice_max(n, n = 10) %>%
  ungroup()

selected_chapters <- 1:7

wordcloud_plots <- map(selected_chapters, function(ch_num) {
  chapter_df <- top_words %>% filter(chapter == ch_num)

  ggplot(chapter_df, aes(label = word, size = n)) +
    geom_text_wordcloud_area(eccentricity = 1) +
    scale_size_area(max_size = 10) +
    labs(title = paste("Speech", ch_num)) +
    theme_minimal()
})

wrap_plots(wordcloud_plots, ncol = 3) +
  plot_annotation(title = "Top 10 Words per Presidents Speech")
```
